item.title: Tinubu departs Lagos for Europe ahead of Abu Dhabi sustainability summit
item.description: President Bola Tinubu on Sunday departed Lagos for Europe as part of his end-of-year break, ahead of his official visit to Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.The President is scheduled to participate in the 2026 edition of the Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week Summit, following an invitation from the President of the United Arab Emirates, Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The summit is expected to hold in early January.According to a statement issued by the President’s Special Adviser on Information

item.title: Gumi speaks as if he's terrorist's commander, says Joe Igbokwe
item.description: A chieftain of the All Progressives Congress, APC, Joe Igbokwe, on Sunday said the actions of Islamic scholar, Sheikh Ahmad Gumi, suggests that he’s above the law.Igbokwe said Gumi is speaking in favour of bandits like he is their commander.Posting on X, he wrote: “Is Sheik Gumi above the law? I have heard him speaking in favour of the bandits. I have seen him having a meeting with well armed bandits.“He speaks as if he is their commander. His actions and deeds suggest that he is above the law.”

item.title: Mozambique beat Gabon 3–2 to end 39-year AFCON win drought
item.description: Mozambique ended a 39-year wait for a first Africa Cup of Nations victory by defeating Gabon 3-2 in a Group F thriller in Agadir on Sunday.The Mambas began the match having drawn four and lost 12 since making their first of six appearances at the tournament in 1986.Goals from Faisal Bangal, Geny Catamo and Diogo Calila won a seesaw struggle for the Mozambicans, who led 2-1 at halftime in the Moroccan coastal city.Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and Alex Moussounda netted for Gabon, who twice halved tw

item.title: Speaker Abbas condemns Zamfara bomb blast that killed seven
item.description: The Speaker of the House of Representatives, Dr Tajudeen Abbas, has condemned the bomb explosion in Zamfara State that claimed the lives of seven people.The incident occurred on Saturday when suspected terrorists planted an Improvised Explosive Device along the Magami–Dansadau highway in Maru Local Government Area of the state.
